[SWS_EthSwt_00448] Behaviour if EthSwtMacAddressLearningMode is set to
IVL
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00087
⌈if EthSwtMacAddressLearningMode is set to IVL then the EthSwt driver shall
return with E_NOT_OK.⌋
Note: If EthSwtMacAddressLearningMode is set to IVL, then the MAC-address to
Ethernet switch port assignment is learned with respect to the according VLAN. With
IVL the presence of an VLAN-ID is needed.
